'''Inaya''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] [[princess]] of [[Hazun]]. While visiting the [[planet]] [[Tenoo]] for a gift for [[Inaya's father|her father]], she was accompanied by the [[droid]] [[PD-4]].<ref name="The Princess and the Jedi" />

==Biography==
Inaya lived during the [[High Republic Era]]. Around [[233 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{YJADate|109A}}</ref> Inaya traveled to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet Tenoo to obtain a gift for her father. While there, her [[starship]] broke down, so she booked passage on the ''[[Crimson Firehawk]]'', [[pilot]]ed by Tenoo local [[Nash Durango]], the latter quite nervous about transporting a passenger of such high status. Durango was supported by her droid [[RJ-83]] and [[Jedi Initiate]]s [[Kai Brightstar]], [[Lys Solay]], and [[Nubs]], who were stationed at the [[Tenoo Jedi Temple]]. Despite PD-4's reservations about the princess taking local transport, Inaya explained that she needed to get home before her father's royal celebration to give him her present, and that repairs on the ship would take too long.<ref name="The Princess and the Jedi" />

The Jedi Initiates helped Inaya store her present in the ''Firehawk'', and the group of younglings took flight for Inaya's home planet. Before they could calculate the jump to [[hyperspace]], the younglings were intercepted by [[Cyrus Vuundir|Taborr Val Dorn]] in his starship, ''[[Iron Talon]].'' Inaya tried to present ideas on how they could lose Val Dorn, but Solay cut her off before she could finish her thought. The ''Firehawk'' crew attempted to evade Val Dorn, but the [[pirate]] shot at them until they lost their [[Deflector shield|shields]] and lateral controls, causing the ship to crash-land atop a [[Tenoo tree]].<ref name="The Princess and the Jedi" />

Durango attempted to fix her ship before [[Taborr's gang]] could reach it, and asked the Jedi Initiates and RJ to help, but neglected to ask her royal passenger for repair help. Nevertheless, Inaya helped Nubs identify a [[flexscope]] and [[hydrospanner]] necessary for repairing the thruster controls. Inaya presented to Durango that the blasts might have disconnected the [[power coupling]]s, but Durango did not listen. Realizing her father's present may be in danger from the pirates, Inaya was alerted to the sounds of Taborr's crew members, [[EB-3]] and [[Pord]], within the ship. As she left the [[cockpit]], she found her present stolen, and caught EB-3 loading it onto the ''Iron Talon''.<ref name="The Princess and the Jedi" /> 

Determined to save the present, Inaya snuck onto the ''Iron Talon'', but the ship took off before Inaya could retrieve the gift or the Jedi could board to assist. After alerting the ''Firehawk'' of her safety via [[comlink]], she used her mechanical skills to override the ''Iron Talon's'' controls, causing Val Dorn to crash the ship closer to the ''Firehawk''. This allowed the other younglings to board the ship and retrieve the present, but Taborr's gang put up a fight. After getting the present secured, Inaya rigged the ship's boarding ramp to close behind the younglings, trapping Val Dorn and his gang inside.<ref name="The Princess and the Jedi" />

By the time the Jedi and Inaya return to the ''Firehawk'', Durango had fixed the ship, realizing that Inaya was correct about the power couplings being disconnected. On their journey back to her home planet, Inaya had the opportunity to pilot the ''Firehawk''. Upon their arrival, Inaya invited her new friends to the royal celebration, but they had to attend to their responsibilities back on Tenoo. Optimistic about returning to fly with her friends in the future, Inaya headed to the party.<ref name="The Princess and the Jedi" />

==Personality and traits==

Inaya was generally very friendly. She did not have expectations that others would treat her with reverence for her status, but appreciated being treated like any other being. Inaya also had interest in flight, admiring Durango's custom modifications on the ''Firehawk'' and that another kid her age got to fly around the [[The galaxy|galaxy]] in her own ship. Indeed, Inaya loved piloting and working on ships, but did not get the opportunity to pursue that interest very often. She sometimes resented how as a princess, others wanted to do everything for her, rather than letting her explore her interests. Therefore, she saw her adventure with the Jedi Initiates as an exciting opportunity for adventure. Inaya was technically skilled, which allowed her to override ship controls while on the ''Iron Talon''.<ref name="The Princess and the Jedi" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Inaya first appeared in "[[The Princess and the Jedi]]," the first part of the [[The Princess and the Jedi / Kai's Bad Day|ninth episode]] of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] and [[Disney Junior]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]'',<ref name="The Princess and the Jedi" /> which aired on [[August 2]], [[2023]].<ref name="More YJA Episodes">{{ThisWeek|aYGTZacheog|A Look at Ahsoka, More Young Jedi Adventures Episodes, and More!|sw_url=video/a-look-at-ahsoka-more-young-jedi-adventures-episodes-and-more}}</ref> The character was voiced by [[Sydney Thomas]].<ref name="YJA 109">{{YJA|The Princess and the Jedi / Kai's Bad Day}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:Artist|Artist]] [[Betsy Bauer]] was responsible for the design of Inaya,<ref name="Design">{{WebCite|url=https://www.betsybauerart.com/character-design|text=Character Design|work=[[Betsy Bauer]]'s [https://www.betsybauerart.com official website]|archivedate=20250125161727}}</ref> while her new outfit in the episode "[[Mine and Ours]]" was modeled by senor artist [[Frank Arndt]].<ref>{{ArtStation|url=artwork/3EoKxE|username=shokunin|name=Frank Arndt|text=Star Wars - Young Jedi Adventures - Season 2 - Character Texturing - Inaya & her outfit - 2023}}</ref>
